key_insight: MOPD integrates multiple specialized RL-trained LLM capabilities by distilling domain teachers on the student’s own rollouts, avoiding exposure bias while preserving near-teacher performance.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical post-training recipe for building frontier LLMs with multiple skills in parallel, reducing cross-domain coupling and improving scalability.
method: Train separate domain-specific RL teachers first.
Run the student on-policy and distill all teachers from the student’s own rollouts.
Combine dense teacher signals to merge capabilities without off-policy mismatch.
evidence_signal: In Qwen3-30B-A3B evaluations, MOPD outperformed Mix-RL, Cascade RL, Off-Policy Finetune, and Param-Merge, while inheriting nearly all of each teacher’s capability.
watch_item: The approach depends on having strong domain teachers and careful coordination of on-policy distillation, which may raise compute and implementation complexity in new domains.
paper_title: MOPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Capability Integration in LLM Post-Training
